verdict.rationale: Community users describe Framer as strong for advanced prototyping with animations and transitions, and use prototypes with real data (framer-comm-2, framer-comm-5). First-party docs only show the AI agent wiring interactive elements like animated menus and carousels from a description, with no code (framer-docs-45). The current docs present Framer mainly as a website builder and never document screen-to-screen prototyping. missing for 10: first-party docs on linking screens into clickable flows, a documented trigger/interaction system, overlay support, transition options for prototypes, and recent hands-on corroboration of no-code prototyping.
